title: Demand/Supply Zone Detection with Trend Reversal Entry

entry_short: Detect 3-bar uptrend (range >200 pips), wait 1-15 bars, enter when price crosses below EMA8

entry_short: 3-bar uptrend (>200 pips range), wait for price below EMA8 = supply zone; grid entry 0.01
